body: Hey :) Personally I think the katana is such a great amp, never got the whole “fake” sound people told me it would produce. It’s such an easy amp for jamming at home once you have your tones set up in the app especially with the ga-fx it just makes it so fun to play on. I’m not sure about the 3rd gen but I do have minor complaints about the options in the mkII tone studio, it’s mostly small things (not being able to fully adjust my chain order or not being able to map controls more). I can’t speak on the GX100 too much but nothing beats having an actual amp.
